symptom: The v64 offline array-boundary test imports ./forwardEvaluationVault.ts; canonical tsconfig uses moduleResolution Bundler with no allowImportingTsExtensions, so scoped typecheck fails TS5097 even though the isolated v64 replay previously reported PASS.
lesson: A green offline TypeScript check using a custom compiler configuration does not establish compatibility with the repository typecheck. Test imports must follow the repository module-resolution contract.
guardrail: Before publishing an offline TypeScript regression patch, run a scoped compiler invocation with the canonical moduleResolution Bundler/noEmit/strict settings and Node types, and prefer the existing .js import convention. Confirm the negative TS5097 case and the corrected compilation.
